what_it_does: Presents a digital power amplifier that converts digital signals into radio-frequency power for wireless applications at 4.7GHz. The chip achieves both high output power (27.7 decibels above one milliwatt) and high efficiency (37.8%), while maintaining low phase distortion (5.8 degrees). This is accomplished through a switched-capacitor power amplifier that uses self-calibration circuitry to detect and compensate for signal delays during high-speed switching, and a specialized transformer design that efficiently combines power from multiple amplifier stages.
